summary:
​MSB NASA EARTH VIEW is an accessible, browser-based multi-sensory sonification engine and 3D Earth Information Jukebox developed for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Tackling the Earth Information Jukebox challenge, our platform bridges a critical accessibility gap for blind and low-vision communities by transforming complex NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) and Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS) visual telemetry into live Web Audio API soundscapes.
​Utilizing a zero-dependency, single-file architecture (index.html), the application scans satellite imagery and 3D WebGL globes in real time, translating thermal RGB warmth into pitch, luminance into volume, and scan coordinates into stereo panning. It features live feeds (NOAA space weather, USGS earthquakes, Open-Meteo air quality, ISS TLE orbital passes), a Scientific Lab with CSV export, and instant real-time translation across 20 languages. Built by MSB Creative Studios. Link : OUR   final project (MSB NASA EARTH VIEW) project LINK : https://msbmsb0706.github.io/MSB-NASA-EARTH-VIEW/
details:
MSB NASA EARTH VIEW translates NASA satellite data and spatial visuals into real-time synthesized music using the browser's Web Audio API. A visual scan line sweeps across satellite frames or a 3D WebGL Earth globe, reading pixel color (thermal warmth), brightness (luminance), and motion to generate live audio waveforms with zero pre-recorded files.

​Benefits & Intended Impact:

  • ​Accessibility: Empowers blind and low-vision individuals to experience climate science and satellite imagery through sound.
  • ​Education & Science: Provides classrooms and researchers with an interactive tool to audit live air quality, active NASA EONET disasters, USGS earthquakes, and space weather storms.

​Tools, Languages & Tech Stack:

  • ​Frontend & Rendering: HTML5 Canvas, Vanilla ES6 JavaScript, hand-written WebGL 1 holographic 3D Earth globe.
  • ​Audio Synthesis: Web Audio API (OscillatorNode, BiquadFilterNode, StereoPannerNode, GainNode, AnalyserNode).
  • ​Live Data Integration: Direct browser fetches to CORS-open public APIs (NASA GIBS, NASA EONET, NOAA SWPC, USGS, Open-Meteo/CAMS, JMA Himawari, api.wheretheiss.at).

​Creativity & Design Considerations:

  • ​Completely self-contained ~510 kB single-file deployment (index.html) requiring no installation, accounts, or backend servers.
  • ​Instant real-time UI translation across 20 languages with automatic RTL layout support (Arabic, Urdu) and strict preservation of scientific numbers in English.
  • ​Built-in video recording, CSV data export, and single-key keyboard navigation.
